final: WITH id_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM id_counts), shares AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share FROM id_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), filtered_shares AS (SELECT cnt, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_record_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as avg_excess FROM filtered_shares    -- Result: (2.0, 0.002597402597402598, 0.001286786607887552)
